en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over an industrial riverside town with hills in the background. A large river flows across the foreground with a steamship and barges on the water. A metal bridge spans the river toward the left. The town is dense with factories, chimneys, warehouses, and residential buildings. The caption text in German is printed at the top in red letters.
